_note: The Bowl's rival companies (GDD §17 v1.85, world doc v1.44 §3.9, docs/bowl-arena-proposal.md §4). Authored text only: names, homes, banners, manners, members and the Crier's lines. Their strength (level, kit, build) is rolled by src/sim/rivals.js from a seed; their grade and rating by src/sim/bowl.js. Ids are API (saves keep them).

crier.won: Your bout. The sun saw it.
crier.lost: Their bout. Get up slow, it looks better.
crier.draw: The sun can't tell you apart. A draw.
crier.time: That's the glass. I'll call it on what's left standing.
crier.champion: Feast-day champions. The sun keeps your name till next feast.

companies.name: The Widow Brack's Three
companies.in: Three in black, and nobody's widow yet.
companies.out: The widow goes home. She'll be back.

companies.name: The Coalbrook Boys
companies.in: The Boys from the pits. Mind your shins.
companies.out: Back down the pit for the Boys.

companies.name: Hesk's Cousins
companies.in: Cousins of the Admiral, they tell me. I wouldn't ask.
companies.out: The Cousins sail home. Count your purse.

companies.name: The Lantern Lads
companies.in: The Guild's own lads. They keep a light; mind it don't keep you.
companies.out: The Lads' light is out. For today.

companies.name: Mabry's Mudlarks
companies.in: Up out of the mud, Mabry's Mudlarks. Check your boots after.
companies.out: Back to the mud with them.

companies.name: The Ninth Milestone Irregulars
companies.in: The Irregulars, nine miles from anywhere and proud of it.
companies.out: The Irregulars march home. It's a long nine miles.

companies.name: Sister Orla's Penitents
companies.in: Sister Orla's Penitents. They've come to suffer, and they're good at it.
companies.out: The Penitents kneel. They seem pleased about it.

companies.name: The Ember Choir
companies.in: The Ember Choir. Stand downwind of nothing.
companies.out: The Choir's gone hoarse.

companies.name: The Reed-Cutters' Lot
companies.in: The Reed-Cutters, up from the Fens with their sickles sharp.
companies.out: The reeds stand another day.

companies.name: Lord Pellam's Men
companies.in: Lord Pellam's Men, paid on time, which is the first I've heard of it.
companies.out: Lord Pellam will want a word.

companies.name: Slagg's Hammers
companies.in: Slagg's Hammers. Everything looks like a nail to them.
companies.out: The Hammers go back to the anvil.

companies.name: The Quiet Company
companies.in: The Quiet Company. They don't talk. They don't need to.
companies.out: The Quiet Company says nothing about it.

companies.name: The Archive Wardens
companies.in: The Archive Wardens, out of the half that isn't burned.
companies.out: Back to the stacks with them. Quietly.

companies.name: The Greywater Hedge
companies.in: The Greywater Hedge. Grown thick and slow to clear.
companies.out: The Hedge is cut back. It grows.

companies.name: The Drovers
companies.in: The Drovers, who've driven worse than you to market.
companies.out: The Drovers go home with the herd.

companies.name: The Candlemakers' Guild
companies.in: The Candlemakers, here to see who burns down first.
companies.out: Snuffed. They'll make more.

companies.name: The Breakwater
companies.in: The Breakwater. Waves have tried.
companies.out: The tide's in over the Breakwater.

companies.name: The Kilnfolk
companies.in: The Kilnfolk. Hot work, and they like it.
companies.out: The kiln's gone cold.

companies.name: The Rookstead Foxes
companies.in: The Rookstead Foxes. Count your hens.
companies.out: The Foxes slip off. The hens are safe.

companies.name: The Lucky Seven
companies.in: The Lucky Seven. There's three of them. Don't ask.
companies.out: The Seven's luck ran out at three.

companies.name: The Frost Wardens
companies.in: The Frost Wardens, down from the Heights. They brought the weather.
companies.out: The Wardens thaw. Not much.

companies.name: The Gravediggers' Union
companies.in: The Gravediggers' Union. They've met the Ashbound and dug them back in.
companies.out: The Union down tools.

companies.name: The Sun Dogs
companies.in: The Sun Dogs, Ma Gorrie's own kennel. Don't feed them.
companies.out: Back in the kennel. Ma won't like it.

companies.name: The Greenwood Kith
companies.in: The Greenwood Kith, out of the trees for the day.
companies.out: The Kith go back under the leaves.
